text:
maya: Quick rollup — glox-7b onboarding. Need a 1-line owner for licensing, perf, infra, and embeddings compatibility. PM wants green by EOD Fri. Drop short status.
ravi: Licensing: started license provenance check. Model repo claims Apache-2.0 but there's a third-party tokenizer with an unclear CLA. @priya I pinged legal ops, filing notes. :eyes:
priya: On it. Saw the tokenizer note — looks like MIT for the tokenizer but there's a bundled script with no license header. Filing a short intake with legal ops now. ETA EOD tomorrow. Not blocking initial canary if we sandbox.
jon: Infra: Staging canary infra is provisioned (dedicated GPU pool + routing). One blocker: model weights exported as bfloat16; our default loader errors on that. Quick traceback:
```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "loader.py", line 42, in load_weights
    raise TypeError("unsupported dtype: bfloat16")
TypeError: unsupported dtype: bfloat16
```
I added a temporary loader branch but need eng-ml review before we ship it to staging.
lex: Perf owner: I'll run two baselines (2k and 8k tokens) on fp16 and int8. Kicking off runs now. Expect preliminary numbers by tomorrow 10:30am PST. Will flag if 99p latency > 1s.
sam: Embeddings pipeline: catalog expects 1536-d vectors but model export is 1408-d. Opened CR#4721 to remap at ingest time, but need model owner confirmation on intended dim. If we remap we add small compute + storage overhead.
maya: Thanks — owners for clarity: @lex perf, @ravi licensing, @jon infra, @sam embeddings. Can everyone drop a 1-line update by EOD? Escalate if blocking. Also please add model profile tag `open-glox` in catalog metadata so routing picks the canonical variant.
ravi: Added metadata issue and linked license intake doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/licensing/glox-7b
priya: Legal ops update: tokenizer dependency MIT, bundled script needs attribution added. Risk level: low. Not a blocker for canary with sandboxing.
jon: Loader patch is in `feature/bf16-loader` — needs 1 review from eng-ml infra. If accepted we can run canary tomorrow 21:00 PST. I also tested routing fallback to a smaller fp16 variant.
ci-bot: deploy-bot: canary job `glox-7b-staging` scheduled for 2026-03-19T21:00:00Z by @jon
lex: Perf results (preliminary): 2k fp16 median 45ms, 8k fp16 median 380ms; int8 median 270ms. 99p tail on 8k int8 = 1.2s. Recommendation: tweak quantization params and enable KV-cache warmup (cold start penalty observed). I'll open PR with tuning knobs and a short README for perf reproducibility.
sam: CR#4721 updated with a mapper; if model owner confirms 1408 vectors we will ship mapper. Pinging model author @alice to confirm. If they intended 1536, we need a rebuild.
maya: Perfect — consolidating into the launch board doc and pinging product. If no blockers after legal + perf tweaks, aim to flip canary->prod next Tue. Thx all :thumbsup:
